_comment: Third-party proof, in one place. Read by the React site (socialProof.ts),
Nothing in this file may be written from memory. Every field is either read
off the third-party page by a human on the date in `asOf` / `retrieved`, or
it does not go in. The review texts are verbatim: they are published on
Trustpilot and Product Hunt under these authors' names, so a tidy-up here is
a misquote of a real person. check-landing-pages.mjs keeps its own second
copy of the three Trustpilot texts on purpose, so an edit here that nobody
checked against the live page fails the build rather than shipping.
fills them in with the date they did it. The UI degrades on purpose: with no
rating the badge is a plain 'Find us on Product Hunt' link, and the review
section does not render at all. An empty block ships a smaller true claim;
a filled-in guess ships a false one.

quotes.text: The overall software experience is top-notch, it's Indian software but feels like US Grade software quality.
quotes.author: Tirth P.

quotes.text: Topedge helped me a lot to solve issues with my ecomm business like abandoned cart followups, complete tracing of what a lead did and where it dropped off. Their support team is very helpful.
quotes.author: Shubham P.

quotes.text: In 2 days their team built me everything on the software... I'm on their ₹1,999 base plan, and mostly every feature is unlocked on every plan.
quotes.author: Robin

customers.name: Delitech Smart Home
customers.headline: Live in the same week they asked
customers.quote: Moksh got our Shopify WhatsApp live the same week we asked. Abandoned carts and COD confirms on one stack — for a smart-home catalog with real AOV, that inbox with order context is what we actually needed.
facts: Shopify + WhatsApp Cloud API connected in the first week
Abandoned cart and COD confirmation running on one stack
Order context beside every chat in the shared inbox

customers.name: Apex Light
customers.headline: One inbox instead of WhatsApp Web and Shopify admin
customers.quote: We were juggling WhatsApp Web and Shopify admin for every order question. TopEdge puts the SKU and COD status beside the chat. Recovery sequences finally feel like Apex, not a generic blast.
facts: SKU and COD status surfaced next to the conversation
Recovery sequences written in the brand's own voice
One inbox in place of WhatsApp Web plus the Shopify admin
